displayIdentity.body: Jesus redirects a kingdom-time question toward Spirit-given power and widening witness, ascends, and the apostles return to Jerusalem for persistent shared prayer with the women and Jesus’ family.
displayIdentity.title: Power, witness, ascension, and united prayer precede the day
